title: Privileged account remained active after termination
observation: Synthetic testing shows a terminated user retained privileged access beyond the expected deprovisioning window.
root_cause: Joiner-mover-leaver workflow was not consistently monitored.
impact: Excess access could allow unauthorized changes or data exposure.
recommendation: Enforce automated deprovisioning checks for terminated identities and review exceptions weekly.
management_response: Management will review IAM exception handling and automate stale-account reporting.

title: Major incident review not completed within SLA
observation: Synthetic incident logs indicate the post-incident review was not completed within the required five-business-day SLA.
root_cause: Incident management team did not track PIR due dates centrally.
impact: Recurring incident causes may remain unidentified and unaddressed.
recommendation: Track PIR due dates and require closure evidence before incident closure.
management_response: Operations will add a PIR tracking board to the major incident process.

title: Change implemented before formal approval
observation: Synthetic change records show implementation activity preceding recorded approver sign-off.
root_cause: Emergency implementation pressure bypassed normal CAB timing.
impact: Unapproved production changes increase operational and compliance risk.
recommendation: Block production implementation when approver sign-off is missing unless emergency workflow is documented.
management_response: CAB will enforce workflow gating in the change tool.

title: Critical vendor assessment expired
observation: Synthetic vendor records indicate the latest assurance review expired before contract renewal.
root_cause: Third-party review calendar did not alert on upcoming expiries.
impact: The organization may rely on a vendor without current assurance evidence.
recommendation: Introduce automated reminders for vendor reviews before contract renewal dates.
management_response: TPRM will align renewal reminders with procurement checkpoints.

title: Access review evidence incomplete
observation: Synthetic access review records show missing reviewer evidence for a subset of privileged users.
root_cause: Review workflow allowed closure without mandatory evidence attachment.
impact: Management cannot demonstrate timely completion of access governance controls.
recommendation: Require reviewer identity and review outcome evidence before marking a review complete.
management_response: IAM governance will update the review checklist and evidence controls.
